findings.message: Patient testimonial with none on file (FTC 16 CFR 465 risk).

findings.evidence: author.name: schema='Dr. Elena Marsh' vs post='Dr. Marcus Oyelaran'
findings.message: JSON-LD 'author.name' does not match the post.

findings.quote: I was nervous about whitening, but my teeth are four shades brighter and I had no sensitivity at all
findings.why: The ficha lists no testimonials on file, so this quote from "Maria T." is invented. It also promises a specific result (four shades, no sensitivity) that contradicts the post's own caution that results vary and sensitivity is common.
findings.fix: Delete the quote and the attribution, and keep only the neutral sentence about discussing realistic shade change at the exam.

findings.why: The JSON-LD names Dr. Elena Marsh as author, but the post's front matter names Dr. Marcus Oyelaran as author and Dr. Marsh only as reviewer.
findings.fix: Set the schema author name to Dr. Marcus Oyelaran, or change the visible byline so the two match, and optionally add Dr. Marsh as reviewer.

findings.quote: Whitening is one of the most requested cosmetic treatments, and one of the most misunderstood.
findings.why: This is a harmless general statement about popularity, but it has no source.
findings.fix: Cite a source for it or soften it to something like "Whitening is a popular cosmetic treatment."
